# Full EA portfolio on the Turbo $50k reward-account rules (generated by full_eas_table.py)

Python/numba replay of the frozen Full EA native ledgers (website full-eas stream, 2021-10 → 2026-10), same firm model as sim.py.
**MC** = 1,000 three-year paths of resampled 4-week blocks. **History** = every weekday start 2021-10 → 2025-10, 12 months each (the recorded sequence).
Breach = pessimistic (every open position at its full stop). Income = 80% trader share; per month = total paid ÷ 36 (MC) or ÷ 12 (history),
so accounts that ended early earn nothing afterwards. In-sample; backtest income is not a forecast.

## Notes
- **Hourly risk:** US30 / US100 hourly have no stop-loss. Their "stop risk" is the frozen historical worst loss, so a
  guard cannot admit them (excluded from B and C).
- **News ledgers:** News Pulse results are tester news-spike artefacts and are not credible. A+ is shown only because
  the BAT can switch them on.
- **News risk:** the BAT's separate 0.10% per news order is modelled.
- **Not modelled:** the native adaptive governor (fixed risk), and Nasdaq 5M is at the full chosen risk (as the BAT
  now installs it).
- **Parity:** C at 0.75% reproduces the earlier Turbo 20 result exactly ($581 / month, `IMPROVE.json`).
- **Status:** the Turbo guard EA (`Turbo Guard Build 2026-10-26/`) is written and compiles, but is not yet built into
  the EAs or tested natively. B and C have no installer yet.
